snippet.title: UNDERSTANDING CIRCULAR KEOGRAMS USING PIZZA
snippet.description:
What happens when you replace an all-sky view of the Aurora with a Pepperoni pizza? Well, this. Hopefully this analogy helps understand the relationship between an timelapse video and a keogram. Just like the night sky, there can be long periods of little activity (like the rising pizza dough) followed by short periods of intense activity (The toppings substorm) It is a lot easier to find the interesting moments using a keogram view of the entire night.
